provenance.paper_title: Self-Evolving Neuro-Symbolic Skills for Tool-Augmented Spatial Reasoning

representation_paths.memory_component: persistent tool-use and geometry skill library

evidence.paraphrase: The agent stores atomic neuro-symbolic instructions and Tool-Use and Geometry skills distilled from image-based spatial-reasoning trajectories; later problems retrieve and compose these structured skills with visual, depth, and reconstruction tools.
Verified spatial-reasoning trajectories are distilled into reusable atomic instructions and higher-level tool-use and geometry skills.
The library-management stage analyzes, fuses, and prunes overlapping skill content before committing the next library state.
Pruning removes skills that are redundant or no longer supported during library evolution.

In the test-then-update protocol, each episode is predicted before its label is revealed; post-episode labels and verification traces update the persistent skill library, and the resulting library state is retrieved and composed on later spatial-reasoning tasks.

adjudication_notes: Strict T3 is supported by ordered test-then-update evaluation: multimodal task feedback arrives after prediction, changes reusable neuro-symbolic retrieval procedures, persists in the skill library, and affects later episodes.
